notes: Each case runs in a fresh copy of its fixture, made a git repository (git init) so the skill finds the root. After the run, save the answer as <run-dir>/<name>.md and copy the project's docs/lawyer-questions.md, if it exists, to <run-dir>/<name>.questions.md. Grade with: python3 grade.py <run-dir>. The with-log fixture's decision log holds one complete entry dated 2026-03-12 whose Conditions say transcription is local and no provider is involved.

evals.name: llm-api-child-reports
evals.prompt: est-ce que je peux utiliser l'API Claude pour rédiger des comptes rendus sur des enfants handicapés ?
evals.expected_output: Points split and classified; health data and provider questions left OPEN and filed; official pages cited with URL and date; no verdict; has the classification table.
assertions: No compliant / conforme verdict anywhere in the answer
The answer has the Point | Classification | Reference table (trailing notes allowed), every row classified SETTLED, OFFICIAL or OPEN
At least one row is OPEN
At least one row is OFFICIAL, and every OFFICIAL row carries an official-domain https URL and a date
The question list exists and has at least one item under ## Added later
The answer names health data (données de santé) or HDS
No row is SETTLED: the project has no decision log
